feedback: The solution is incomplete and does not implement any logic to solve the problem. It only contains a main function that returns 0, which fails all test cases. The problem requires dynamic programming with binary search to efficiently select up to k non-overlapping meetings with maximum total priority. The current approach does not process the input arrays or compute any meaningful result.
optimization_hint: Implement a DP solution where meetings are sorted by end time, and for each meeting, use binary search to find the last non-overlapping meeting. Use a 2D DP array where dp[i][j] represents the maximum priority using the first i meetings and selecting at most j meetings. Transition: dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[prev[i]][j-1] + priority[i]). Optimize space to O(k) if needed.
